description: This Java source file defines a servlet filter implementation called ControlFilter used within the Apache OFBiz framework. Its main purpose is to restrict access to certain paths based on an allowlist, manage redirection, and perform security checks on incoming HTTP requests.

classes.name: ControlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that enforces an allowlist of URL paths, manages redirections, and performs security checks on incoming requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter configuration, reading parameters for redirect paths, error codes, allowed paths, and redirect behavior.

methods.name: readErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a string error code to an integer; defaults to 403 if parsing fails.

methods.name: readAllowedPaths
methods.description: Parses and returns a set of allowed path prefixes from a colon-separated string.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the configured redirect path, handling relative or absolute URLs.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main logic for filtering incoming requests: enforces allowlist, performs security checks, handles redirection, and blocks malicious or malformed URLs.
